I am wondering if CL clients assume that the payload is `VALID` upon receiving `Invalid payload attributes` or any other error in the response to the `fcU` call? The context is here https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/479 We're seeing these messages, they are delivered by Nimbus but it could be anyone, in any case I think Nimbus should not be broadcasting these ``` time="2023-10-23 12:44:20" level=debug msg="Gossip message was ignored" agent=nimbus error="epoch 35 root 0x98cccf892929bcedb7f028d18a1945204de35589beb794249d8a6f064f395cd9: not a checkpoint in forkchoice" gossip score=1.9558940606976583 multiaddress="/ip4/157.230.177.155/tcp/48936" peer id=16Uiu2HAmRN9fxqjdyaX3XGw28fr5g2NSgHumL3jesuZNL7WkqcKc prefix=sync topic="/eth2/4c402a37/beacon_aggregate_and_proof/ssz_snappy" ``` Someone is attesting to a block in the middle of the epoch, with a parent in the middle of the epoch, and using that blockroot as a checkpoint that cannot pass gossip validation cc <@654267572107083777> the peer belongs to nimbus-erigon-1 hive should be fixed now, all clients tests should run through soon 😄 finally got it up and runnig https://dencun-devnet-10.beaconcha.in/ (blobs not indexed yet) arm boxes 🔥 looks like nginx issue on the arm boxes will check Seems like epoch 56 has not finalized yet? now it has <@755590043632140352> is that check required? Not obvious to me from https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md#beacon_aggregate_and_proof it is the explorer will lag a bit on epoch-transition https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/blob/8b07f4fd4c58ffd05f6c3b2753b24883b162a96d/beacon_chain/gossip_processing/gossip_validation.nim#L927-L933 treats it implicitly But it doesn't check anything specific to checkpoints, only that basically the block it refers to exists Seems okay by https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/fork-choice.md#get_checkpoint_block fyi: I'm re-adding the blobber to test the prysm fix from last week. blobber will run on lighthouse-nethermind-1 and lighthouse-reth-1, expect no chaos (hopefully :D) I think you' re right, we discussed this only internally when we added this check: this was the result of the spamming of bad attestations in mainnet a while ago, we realized that there were plenty that were being gossiped that are worthless for everyone. It's a simple and cheap check, perhaps it makes sense to add it for the target checkpoint <@199561711278227457> I don' t think that branch has an initial sync fix, only regular sync, so launch blobber if prysm is already synced 🙂 Yeah the nodes are synced to head, waiting till they were to launch 😄 so lets see, its been a good 10mins and nothing happened so far. Mario is running that branch on hive as well to check. <@654267572107083777> regardless of the gossip rules, you may want to check since all the messages I can find are from Nimbus, whether you are attesting for an invalid checkpoint: there's no way any forkchoice can have those roots in an actual checkpoint, no matter how badly synced the node
